title: Listening around and lessons from Dickinson and Maurice Duran
summary: He learned by going around listening; Duran coached him most.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Yeah. You used to go around and listen. Go around them, you see. I love music and I wanted to learn. I go to these places and I get acquainted with the fellas, you see.
Let's go to the alley and get a drink.
Yeah, did you ever take any lessons from anybody else?

Well, I took some lessons from Professor Dickinson. Yeah, I know you told me, but- A few lessons from him. Did you take lessons from any well-known? No, no. Maurice Duran was the one that coached me the most with the trophy.
